about: Vehicle roster, ordered weakest to strongest: classes run scouts -> highway -> heavy-duty -> offroad -> heavy, 20 per class, one per unlock rank (rank 1 is the free starter), ranked by power. Every kind of vehicle is welcome: some carry a load drawn into their art and counted in their mass (load), many carry nothing. There is no length cap: long rigs are framed by their own zoom and the in-game zoom button. Tires are fixed (wheelType, see wheel-types.json): to get something stronger, switch cars. Names and art briefs are original designs inspired by kinds of real vehicles (SnowRunner trucks, Forza Horizon off-roaders, rally cars and supercars), never a real make or model. Service trucks: one breakdown truck per class, bigger and stronger class by class, that winches and tows (towMassT is the heaviest gross weight it pulls); they never get stuck or run out of fuel and are the most powerful vehicles of their class but not the fastest. status: playable (car.json and art exist), planned, needs-art.

classes.name: Scouts
classes.about: Light vehicles of every kind: classic and modern 4×4s, SUVs, pickups, buggies, UTVs, rally cars and supercars on off-road tyres. Some carry small loads, many carry nothing.

classes.name: Highway
classes.about: Road vehicles: vans, fast SUVs and grand tourers on all-terrain tyres, rigid trucks and semi tractors with their trailers. Quick and strong on firm roads, struggle off-road.

classes.name: Heavy Duty
classes.about: Work trucks for logging, construction, utilities, fire and rescue, plus heavy-duty pickups: strong, geared low, decent off-road.

classes.name: Off-road
classes.about: Cross-country trucks: army 6×6s and 8×8s, amphibians, swamp buggies, Arctic haulers and balloon-tyre crawlers built for mud, water, snow and rock.

classes.name: Heavy
classes.about: Huge prime movers, mobile cranes and mining giants: slow, enormous torque, oversize loads.
